content_html:
If you are a lover of unique landscapes and off-the-beaten-path destinations in Peru, the Choqolaqa Stone Forest is definitely a place you should consider.

Located in the southern Andean region of Peru, this incredible natural landscape looks like it was taken from another planet, with giant rock formations shaped by nature over thousands of years.

In this guide, we explain why this destination is becoming a hidden gem of adventure tourism.

What is the Choqolaqa Stone Forest?

The Choqolaqa Stone Forest is a natural geological formation made up of massive rock structures that rise like sculptures in the middle of the mountains.

Unlike other more well-known tourist destinations, you won’t find crowds here, but instead silence, pure nature, and breathtaking landscapes.

This place is ideal for travelers looking for authentic experiences, trekking, and direct contact with nature.

Watch the Choqolaqa Stone Forest in video

Before continuing, you can see what this incredible destination looks like in motion:

https://www.facebook.com/reel/996530782961769

Why visit Choqolaqa?

This destination is special not only for its beauty but also for the experience it offers:

Unique “stone forest” landscapes
Very low tourism (exclusive experience)
Ideal for trekking and photography
Direct connection with Andean nature
Feeling of exploring a pristine place

It is perfect for travelers who have already visited Cusco or Arequipa and are looking for something different and off the beaten path.

Location and access

The Choqolaqa Stone Forest is located in the southern Andean region of Peru, within mountain routes that require prior planning.

Access is usually done through guided tours or expeditions due to the difficulty of the terrain.

Recommendations before traveling

Bring warm clothing (cold high-altitude climate)
Wear trekking shoes
Acclimatize beforehand if coming from Lima or lower areas
Bring water and snacks
Go with a guide or organized tour
